## Result

* Columns: same names and order (31 columns: Time, V1, V2, …, Amount, Class): yes.
* Cells compared: 8,829,017. Text differences (quotes removed): 0; differences after parsing to float64: 0; class-label differences: 0.
* Row order: row-by-row identical: yes.
* Formatting differs only in quoting: the ARFF quotes the class values (`'0'`), the CSV quotes its header and class values (`"0"`). The numbers are written identically in both, including the one value in exponent notation (`1e+05`), so parsing introduces no difference. Loader output (`ulb.parse_arff` vs `ulb.parse_csv`) identical: yes.

Conclusion: the data rows are identical. The original benchmark was run on the OpenML copy and its provenance is recorded as such; the Kaggle listing is now the preferred acquisition route because it is the owner-listed source and states the licence.

Contains information from [Credit Card Fraud Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/mlg-ulb/creditcardfraud), which is made available here under the [Open Database License (ODbL)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/).
